captions.caption: A person offers a piece of food to a crow on a paved patio, while a large dog lies nearby observing; after the crow takes the food, the person drops a ball, and the dog watches the crow interact with it.
A black crow boldly approaches a resting German Shepherd on a paved patio, pecking at a small yellow ball between them, while the dog watches intently, creating a tense standoff over the object.

A German Shepherd lies calmly on a paved patio, watching a black crow that approaches and pecks at a small, pale ball near the dog’s paw. After a brief, tense standoff, the crow suddenly flees, and the dog remains still, its attention fixed on the spot where the bird disappeared.

A person tosses a small ball onto a paved patio, and a black bird swiftly darts out from under a white plastic chair to chase after it, briefly disappearing behind a metal structure before reappearing as the ball rolls away.

A black bird pecks at a small white object on a paved patio, drawing the attention of a German Shepherd dog that approaches cautiously, while a white plastic chair and potted plants frame the outdoor scene.
A German Shepherd dog walks purposefully across a stone patio, its attention fixed on a small white object on the ground, while a black bird scurries nearby among potted plants and buckets.

A German Shepherd dog is seen sniffing a small white ball on a paved patio, then the dog exits the frame, leaving the ball behind. A black crow then approaches the ball, pecks at it, and walks away toward the background, passing near a white plastic chair and some outdoor storage items.
A small black bird walks across a paved patio, moving from the foreground toward the background near a green trash can and some stacked chairs, before disappearing behind the wall.
